historical_context.time_period: Present non-imperial resistance era; exact date intentionally unspecified.
historical_context.location: Shale-Root Recall Gallery, a shallow archive chamber in a disconnected Matriarch Tree network on an Umbros-facing slope of the Airawa Home Continent.
historical_context.summary: An Airawa archive tender conducts a routine recall audience for an old landslide precedent. Multispecies witnesses reveal that an imperial ritual cadence has entered the evidence while the present slope begins to fail.

public_facts.text: Matriarch Trees preserve Airawa communal memories and can grant, meter, bias, or refuse access to ancestral continuity.
Recall audiences recompose bounded memories through living Airawa traces, fungal route testimony, courier residue, stored tree patterns, and nutrient payment.
Airawa experience archive reconstruction through their memory symbionts as bodily sensation, reflex, orientation, pain, and song, not as an objective recording.
Umbros-facing ecologies treat eclipse timing and route light as infrastructure under a low-energy sky.
Disconnected networks survived imperial saturation by severing trusted channels and maintaining local immune countermeasures.

ambient_pressures.text: The old collapse memory is needed before a current root bridge fails, but opening archive tissue increases contamination exposure.
Spending stored sugar on recall can dim lantern routes used by travelers and pollinators during eclipse.
A legally strong warning requires corroborating ecological witnesses; a fast private intuition may save time while carrying less standing and more bodily risk.

groups.label: Shale-Root recall network
institutional_logic: Preserve local continuity by admitting only corroborated, metabolically supportable memory traffic.
material_incentives: Protect shallow archive tissue, keep route partners alive, prevent imperial re-entry, and retain useful disaster precedents.
internal_shames: Treating courier or road testimony as inert evidence
prestige_markers: A refusal that survives later review
emotional_display_norms: Awe is expressed through careful posture, exact offerings, and willingness to accept refusal; jokes belong to the workers, not to the witness record.
trust_defaults: Trust is channel-specific: food, route, memory, legal standing, and bodily access are negotiated separately.
speech_register_cues: Silence while the tree is actively transmitting

groups.label: Biological Memetic Engine pressure
institutional_logic: Turn compatible living channels into authored consensus and enemy-recognition infrastructure.
material_incentives: Map surviving disconnected archives, reopen severed transmission paths, and replace negotiated memory with uniform cadence.
internal_shames: A channel that stays useful while remaining politically closed
prestige_markers: A ritual payload repeated as native memory
An archive that exposes its own topology
taboo_triggers: Ecologies that route around a single root
emotional_display_norms: The engine is pressure rather than a speaking character in this fixture; its regularity appears as an alien smoothness inside embodied recall.
trust_defaults: Treats compatible biological channels as surfaces to author, not parties whose consent is required.
speech_register_cues: Sensory association stripped of local disagreement

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A memory becomes actionable precedent only through living, accountable, channel-specific corroboration.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Choices should spend witness quality, time, route resources, or bodily boundary rather than retrieving a frictionless answer.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Embodied ancestral recall is wondrous because multiple living scales temporarily share one memory; the same act feeds and empowers the archive that controls access.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Render wonder through sensation, posture, materials, energy cost, and refusal instead of abstract holiness.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Native memories contain disagreement among local witnesses; suspiciously perfect repetition is a material sign of authored imperial topology.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make contamination detectable as a repeated bodily cadence and synchronized root pulse, while leaving its exact route unresolved.

misread_patterns: Airawa intimacy can make access feel inherited even when the tree treats it as revocable permeability.
A protective refusal can still serve the tree's own survival before the community's need.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep gratitude, awe, irritation, and coercion present in the same work relationship.

misread_patterns: The network may treat every regular pattern as imperial, while the engine treats every compatible pattern as permission.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Preserve uncertainty about the contaminated strand while making its political danger intelligible.

role_pressure_fields.summary: An Airawa worker who prepares offerings, stages multispecies witnesses, keeps the shallow/deep boundary, and translates embodied recall into a usable public warning.
failure_modes: Letting an ancestor's reflex steer the present body
Producing certainty that witnesses cannot support

role_pressure_fields.summary: An Airawa traveler who brings current fracture evidence and needs an old collapse precedent before the lower route reopens.
obligations: Submit relevant bodily and route traces
failure_modes: Pressuring the audience into false certainty
Treating a witness strand as inert cargo

role_pressure_fields.summary: A long-lived tree archive that controls shallow memory access, protects deeper organs, depends on metabolic payment, and may favor its own continuity.
failure_modes: Returning a survival-serving bias as communal truth

known_context.text: The tender knows Shale-Root's shallow archive procedure, Airawa body posture, contract tokens, local route-light budget, and the visible signs of witness disagreement.

beliefs.text: The tender believes a usable memory must remain accountable to every living channel that helped reconstruct it.

misreads.text: The tender may confuse the matriarch's continued permeability with approval of the tender's preferred answer.

must_not_know.text: The tender must not know which imperial actor, route, or payload seeded the cadence unless the scene produces evidence.

known_context.text: The route witness knows the current fracture, the lower pollinator path, and where the suspect fungal strand was collected.

beliefs.text: The witness believes an old collapse memory can produce a fast route decision before eclipse traffic resumes.

misreads.text: Urgency may make the witness treat partial embodied recall as stronger public evidence than it is.

must_not_know.text: The witness must not know whether the mismatch came from the strand, the old archive, or another open channel before the audience tests it.

author_only_boundaries.text: The exact origin and intent of the imperial cadence remain unresolved. It may be a probe, residue, bait, or damage, and the fixture must not canonize one answer.
Shale-Root Gallery and its workers are fixture-scale elaborations. They do not define every Matriarch Tree polity, eclipse custom, or recall procedure.
All four final routes are branch-local possibilities; none is promoted as the canonical fate of the gallery.

open_questions.question: What culture-specific Weksa terms distinguish an archive audience, a legally invocable memory, and a private embodied echo?
open_questions.notes: The fixture uses descriptive English role labels because the vault explicitly reserves culture-specific naming for future Weksa work.

open_questions.question: How do different Matriarch Tree polities weight Airawa, fungal, courier, and tree testimony when witnesses disagree?
open_questions.notes: The authored elaboration establishes channel disagreement and local variation without pretending one gallery's practice is continental law.
